headline: Q2 2026 earnings preview: consensus non-GAAP EPS $0.47–$0.52, revenue ~$25.99B — options market pricing 7.6% move on Jul 22; key debate is auto gross margin (ex-credits): bear case 16.8% vs consensus 18.2% and Q1's 21.1%; would mark a step-up from Q2 2025's $22.5B revenue / $1.2B net income; market has deliveries (+25% YoY blowout); earnings call focus will be Cybercab passenger launch timeline, Optimus unit count, and capex/FCF trajectory (TipRanks / CoinCentral / notateslaapp, Jul 17, 2026)

BofA reiterates Buy / $460 PT: Texas robotaxi fleet hits 175 vehicles — fastest fleet growth tracked by any analyst; 22 total incidents since launch with zero serious injuries or fatalities; Tesla 21% cheaper than Waymo/Uber/Lyft in San Francisco despite 3–4x longer wait times; Optimus Fremont production start late July/August + Gen 3 reveal flagged as imminent catalyst; NatPower 25+ GWh European BESS deal highlighted as energy upside (BofA / Yahoo Finance / ProactiveInvestors, Jul 17, 2026)

Tesla Texas robotaxi fleet expands 50%+ in a single day to 175 total unsupervised vehicles — fastest single-month growth (+100 vehicles) among all robotaxi operators tracked; now operational in 5 markets (Austin, Dallas, Houston, Miami, SF supervised); Morgan Stanley projects 1,000 vehicles by year-end 2026 — requires ~5x current Texas base (eletric-vehicles.com / Morgan Stanley, Jul 16–17, 2026)

notateslaapp: NTSB preliminary report DEFINITIVELY vindicates Tesla FSD in fatal Texas house crash — driver applied 100% accelerator override at moment of impact; FSD was not engaged; eliminates any ambiguity about system vs driver responsibility; reinforces bull narrative ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings; confirms pattern of driver-error misattribution to Tesla's AI stack (notateslaapp / TeslaNorth, Jul 16–17, 2026)

Gary Black: SpaceX can't afford to buy Tesla — 'the math won't pass muster'; SPCX trading at ~$132 (below $135 IPO price) with further -1.82% premarket decline July 17; an equity-funded acquisition would dilute SPCX shareholders ~25%; Black: Musk's 82% voting control does not override board fiduciary duty to SpaceX shareholders; TSLA slipped 1% Thursday to $391.06 (2nd consecutive red session); Chamath Palihapitiya, Jefferies, and JPMorgan still argue strategic logic holds; Q2 EPS consensus $0.32 expected Jul 22 (Stocktwits / X, Jul 17, 2026)

Motley Fool: don't rush to buy Tesla before July 22 earnings — no game-changing Optimus or FSD v15 announcements expected; key investment case is recurring income from FSD subscriptions, Optimus robot-as-a-service, and robotaxi fleet revenue; stock has room to run long-term but no near-term catalyst demands immediate action ahead of the report (Motley Fool, Jul 17, 2026)

Electrek: Tesla shareholders begging Musk to explain missed goals ahead of Jul 22 Q2 earnings — most-upvoted Q&A portal questions demand Musk account for why Tesla has missed its own short-term targets 3 earnings in a row on robotaxi, FSD, and Optimus; tone shifted from 'when will the vision arrive?' to 'why aren't stated targets being met?'; Electrek calls it 'a bleak story' for retail investors promised commercial robotaxi scale by mid-2026 (Electrek, Jul 16, 2026)

notateslaapp Q2 earnings call preview: production-ready Optimus Gen 3 prototype reveal imminent — shareholders expect Optimus Gen 3 public unveil, first official unit production count, AI chip roadmap update (AI5 engineering samples, AI6 tapeout timeline), and TERAFAB progress milestone at Jul 22 call; Optimus production line confirmed installed at Fremont July 14; Musk's prior 'late July or August' start commitment now directly testable against earnings disclosure (notateslaapp, Jul 16, 2026)

Tesla Q2 2026 energy deployment: 13.5 GWh (+53% QoQ) — record Q2 in company history, confirms Q1 8.8 GWh miss was timing not demand — at Q2 run-rate Tesla tracking toward ~54 GWh full-year 2026 vs ~48 GWh consensus; energy gross margins to be revealed Jul 22; energy recovery removes key bear narrative from Q1 and directly supports $10B+ energy revenue thesis for full-year 2026 (teslaoracle.com / Tesla IR, Jul 15, 2026)
